content.value: A magnetic circuit shown in the figure consist of a cast iron semi-circle having outer and inner diameter 10 and 4 inch respectively. This cast iron semi-circle is connected perfectly to a cast steel slab having volume 160 cubic inches. The width and the thickness of the slab is equal and the length is 19 times higher than the width. Determine the MMF required to establish a flux of 2 mW in the magnetic circuit. The relative permeability of cast iron and cast steel are 5000, 4000 respectively.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2020
